note: Radicali ditiadiazolilici (DTDA) 4'-alcossi-tetrafluorofenil p-ROC6F4CNSSN, R = Me (1), Et (2), nPr (3), nBu (4). Il derivato etossilico 2 e' polimorfo: 2α (dimeri cis-oidi, impilamento AA'BB'), 2β e 2γ (impilamento AA'AA', miscela di dimeri e monomeri). Transizioni: 2α -> 2β irreversibile riscaldando (circa 76 °C, via fusione e ricristallizzazione), 2β <-> 2γ reversibile a circa -25 °C (da Z' = 6 a Z' = 14, supercella, rotazione e traslazione dell'anello DTDA, isteresi piccola), 3 passa per una fase intermedia vetrosa o liquido-cristallina fra 64 e 91 °C. Le temperature del testo sono onset DSC («values quoted in the text refer to onset temperatures (Tonset)»). Rapporto dimeri:monomeri 1:1 in 2β e 3:1 in 2γ, con effetto sulla risposta magnetica (il χT sale quando la 2β ha piu' monomeri). Non sono eventi: i calcoli di accoppiamento di scambio, le misure SQUID di 2α oltre i 250 K (paramagnetismo da popolazione termica del tripletto o dissociazione dei dimeri, modello di equilibrio monomero-dimero con ΔHdim = -30 kJ mol-1) e il confronto di struttura fra 1-4. Il testo non da' CCDC ne' refcode: i cif di 1-4 (anche i dati a temperatura variabile di 2α fra 103 e 268 K) sono nel supplementare. Incoerenze del testo: (1) «At 75(2) oC PXRD studies revealed 2α had converted to 2β (Fig. 6)»: la figura giusta e' la 7; (2) le densita' del testo (2α = 1.842, 2β = 1.781, 2γ = 1.821 g cm-3) non coincidono con quelle della Tabella 1 (1.817, 1.780, 1.822); (3) «surge in the value of χT commences around 340 K ... associated with the melting of 2α»: la misura SQUID e' di 2α, ma DSC e PXRD mostrano che 2α passa a 2β a 76 °C e 2β fonde a 80 °C; (4) le variazioni PXRD «the disappearance of weak peaks around 7o and 16o ... on cooling to -25 oC»: la scomparsa dei picchi deboli di supercella e' del riscaldamento 2γ -> 2β, non del raffreddamento; (5) le sezioni di testo riportano lo stesso evento DSC come -25 oC e come -25 °C.

forme.note: Radicale 1 (R = Me), un'unica fase cristallina. Un dimero cis-oide (due molecole indipendenti) nell'unita' asimmetrica, π-stacking AA'AA' lungo a. Colonna «1» della Tabella 1 (150 K).

citazioni: A summary of the thermodynamic data determined from DSC studies for 1 – 4 is presented in Table S2 and values quoted in the text refer to onset temperatures (Tonset).
At 75(2) oC PXRD studies revealed 2α had converted to 2β (Fig. 6).

DSC studies on a pure sample of 2α revealed the presence of two successive endothermic transitions on warming at +76 and +80 °C with a total enthalpy change of ∆H = +20 kJ·mol-1 on the heating cycle (ESI, Fig. S6). The first transition is attributed to the conversion of 2α to 2β whereas the second is attributed to the melt of 2β.

A comparison of the structures of 2α and 2β reveal that the transformation of 2α to 2β requires a major lattice reorganisation (50% of molecules to undergo a 180o rotation or 100% of molecules to undergo a 90o rotation).
Previous studies have identified such major lattice reorganizations occur via a melt/recrystallization process.
The significant structural differences between 2α and 2β are reflected in a melt-recrystallisation process for the irreversible endothermic

Detailed differential scanning calorimetry and variable temperature powder X-ray diffraction studies coupled with SQUID magnetometry have been used to show that 2α converts irreversibly to 2β upon heating

eventi.note: Conversione 2α -> 2β: DSC 76 °C (onset) e PXRD 75(2) °C, concordi, quindi un solo evento. Il secondo picco DSC a +80 °C e' la fusione di 2β (E4); l'entalpia totale +20 kJ mol-1 e' la somma delle due transizioni. Il processo e' endotermico e guidato dall'entropia. Gli autori lo dicono irreversibile; l'assenza del ritorno e' in E2. Lettura magnetica diversa: «A surge in the value of χT commences around 340 K ... associated with the melting of 2α» (SQUID su 2α), che non distingue 2α -> 2β dalla fusione.

citazioni: Crystals of 2β were collected at +30 oC but underwent a phase transition below -25 oC to form 2γ upon cooling, confirmed by DSC measurements (ESI, Fig. S6).
On cooling below -25 oC, 2β undergoes a reversible phase transition to 2γ which is evident in variable temperature powder X-ray diffraction (VT-PXRD) and DSC studies (vide infra).
Variable temperature PXRD profiles of 2β on cooling, converting to 2γ at -25 oC and subsequent conversion back to 2β on warming to room temperature.
On cooling a small transition at -30
was recorded reflecting the reversible nature of the 2γ to 2β transition.
Both 2β and 2γ showed a propensity for twinning and cooling through the phase transition led to significant degradation in crystal quality.
The emergence of new reflections was consistent with the formation of a super-cell.
A full dataset was measured at 173 K (75 K below the phase transition) on a crystal cooled through the phase transition.
Such single crystal to single crystal phase transitions are not without precedent in thiazyl radical chemistry.

La frase sul VT-PXRD («disappearance of weak peaks around 7o and 16o ... on cooling to -25 oC») e' contraddittoria con la comparsa di nuove riflessioni (supercella) raffreddando: non e' usata.

DSC studies on a pure sample of 2β heated from -60 to +150 °C revealed two endothermic transitions occurring at -25 °C and +78 °C. The transition at -25 oC is associated with the phase transition from the low temperature phase 2γ to the high temperature phase 2β, corroborated by single crystal and PXRD studies (Fig. 8). The enthalpy change associated with this process (+0.6 kJ·mol-1) is extremely small.
In addition the re-emergence of the original PXRD profile on warming back to room temperature confirmed the reversible nature of the 2β ↔ 2γ transition seen in DSC studies.
eventi.note: Ritorno 2γ -> 2β riscaldando: onset DSC -25 °C (+0.6 kJ mol-1, molto piccola), confermata da cristallo singolo e PXRD. Il picco di capacita' termica sta a 259 K (scan 0.1 K min-1). La conversione riscaldando e' guidata dall'entropia (piu' monomeri disordinati). Il DSC in raffreddamento e' in E6.

citazioni: Additional studies of the phase transition 2β ↔ 2γ in heating and cooling modes confirm the reversible nature of the transition and presence of a small thermal hysteresis loop. If the onset temperatures for the phase transition on heating/cooling are considered then there is negligible hysteresis (TC = 257(1) K) but if the transition temperatures are defined by the maximum change in gradient of χT(T) then this affords (TC(↑) = 261(1) K, TC(↓) = 256(1) K (scan rate = 1 K·min-1)(Fig. 10).
Additional heating and cooling cycles on 2β (46 mg) mounted in a gelatin capsule were undertaken in applied fields of 500 Oe to probe the solid-state transition between 2β and 2γ.
eventi.note: Stessa transizione di E6 vista dalla risposta magnetica χT(T) (SQUID, campo applicato 500 Oe, 1 K min-1): TC(↓) = 256(1) K al massimo della variazione di pendenza; con gli onset l'isteresi e' trascurabile (TC = 257(1) K). La risposta magnetica cambia perche' 2β ha un monomero ogni dimero e 2γ uno ogni tre: χT passa da 0.057 a 0.089 emu K mol-1 fra 246 e 264 K. La tecnica (SQUID) non e' nel vocabolario: «altro». From 246 to 264 K there is a step in the value of χT, increasing to 0.089 emu·K·mol-1, a little less than that predicted for one third of the molecules contributing to sample paramagnetism (0.125 emu·K·mol-1) anticipated from the structure of 2β.
